threats.limitation: single-maintainer account and workstation remain external trust anchors
advisory data and reachability judgments can lag
a previously unknown upstream compromise may evade advisory scanners

threats.threat: Compromised Maven plugin or build tool
threats.limitation: plugin transitive behavior still requires upstream trust
approved upstream SHA can itself be malicious

threats.threat: Secret exfiltration by workflow or build
threats.limitation: GITHUB_TOKEN and runner credentials remain platform-managed

threats.threat: Accidental secret committed to source or history
threats.limitation: pattern scanners cannot recognize every secret format
real signing workstation remains an external trust boundary
consumer repository configuration is outside project control

threats.threat: Untrusted pull request executes on persistent runner
threats.limitation: public PR CI must migrate before REL1

preventive: separate local signing and Portal authorization
threats.limitation: owner remains the sole authorization authority

threats.response: remove, replace, or explicitly review dependency
threats.limitation: engineering audit is not a legal opinion

threats.threat: Mutable or compromised PostgreSQL container image
threats.limitation: tags are not pinned by manifest digest

threats.threat: SQL injection through identifiers or values
threats.response: fix source and remove obsolete exclusion
threats.limitation: three internal structured-SQL sinks require narrow exclusions

threats.threat: Denial of service through unbounded caller input or callbacks
threats.response: caller timeouts, cardinality validation, and pool controls
threats.limitation: hostile or infinite caller code is outside the library authority

external_prerequisites.description: Approved and tested private vulnerability reporting channel
Verified offline OpenPGP backup and revocation recovery
Named Maven Central Portal token created only after authorization

residual_risks.description: Single maintainer and account/workstation trust concentration
residual_risks.control: MFA, manual authorization, CI evidence and compromise runbook

residual_risks.description: Persistent Docker-capable runner has root-equivalent host reach
residual_risks.control: owner-only jobs, repository-scoped registration and health checks
blocks: external PR execution on self-hosted runner

residual_risks.description: PostgreSQL container patch tags are mutable rather than digest-pinned
residual_risks.control: exact tags, trusted registry path, smoke and compatibility tests

residual_risks.description: Five reviewed OSV findings remain accepted
residual_risks.control: exact scope/reachability records and expiry gate

residual_risks.description: Six exact SpotBugs exclusions remain analyzer limitations
residual_risks.control: Bug/Class/Method scope, source-target and expiry gates

residual_risks.description: Eight exact production license reviews require periodic renewal
residual_risks.control: coordinate/version/license exact match and expiry gate

residual_risks.description: Public-repository PVR, rulesets and external-PR isolation are not active
residual_risks.control: REL1 activation checklist and current private owner-only boundary

residual_risks.description: No SLSA claim, native attestation or Sigstore identity
residual_risks.control: source-bound inventory, reproducibility, SHA-256 and OpenPGP

residual_risks.description: Caller-controlled infinite input, cardinality and callbacks can exhaust resources
residual_risks.control: bounded batching, streaming, documented validation and timeouts

scanner_gap_review.trigger: public repository or supported private entitlement plus a demonstrated dataflow gap
a concrete source pattern not covered by SpotBugs/FindSecBugs and tests
material OSV/Dependabot advisory or Maven graph coverage gap
need for NVD/CPE cross-check after an OSV discrepancy
maintainability need not met by current local gates
public repository activation where signals become representative
artifact channel requiring a second identity model beyond Central OpenPGP
public visibility or private entitlement with an approved provenance design
